questions.q: In its World Economic Outlook of October 2026, the IMF projected India's GDP growth for FY2026-27 at:

questions.fact: IMF WEO October 2026 projects India's FY2026-27 growth at 7.0%.

questions.q: What was India's rank among 122 countries in the Global Hunger Index 2026, released in October 2026?

questions.fact: India ranked 100th of 122 countries in the Global Hunger Index 2026 (score 24.1, serious).
